title: Off-canvas side drawer and bottom sheet
when: The user wants a panel that slides in from the side, such as a cart, filters or settings, without leaving the page.
prompt:
Goal: A sliding panel that behaves as a modal dialog on desktop and rises as a bottom sheet on phones.
Steps:
1. <dialog class="drawer" aria-labelledby="drawer-title"> opened with showModal(); margin 0, inset-block: 0, inset-inline-end: 0.
2. Height 100dvh, width min(24rem, 90vw); header with title and Close button, a scrolling body, a footer with the main action.
3. Slide from transform: translateX(100%) on open with @starting-style; no transform transition under prefers-reduced-motion.
4. Below 600 px make it a bottom sheet: full width, max-height 85dvh, inset-block-start: auto, rounded top corners.
5. Close on Escape, backdrop click and Close; return focus to the trigger on the close event.
Quality bar:
- The main action stays visible while the body scrolls.
- The trigger shows the state the panel holds (Cart, 2 items).
- The page behind does not scroll while open.
Pitfalls:
- A div moved off screen that still receives focus.
- Animations firing on page load.
- A drawer that covers the full screen on desktop.
Verify:
- [ ] The drawer is a dialog with aria-labelledby and Close.
- [ ] Focus moves in and back to the trigger.
- [ ] Bottom sheet layout at 375 px.
- [ ] Reduced motion removes the slide.
Output: Drawer markup, drawer.css with slide and sheet rules, drawer.js.

examples.input: carrinho lateral que desliza da direita
examples.output: dialog drawer with Cart title, scrolling item list, sticky Checkout button, bottom sheet under 600 px
